name: minigpt-app
description: MiniGPT - Production-quality AI Personal Assistant with Router Architecture

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma@5.16.0 generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build:vercel: npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
